title: Bidirectional Random Projections
summary: This paper analyzes bidirectional random projections for ordinary least squares (OLS) regression under the fixed design setting. Let $(X,Y) \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times p} \times \mathbb{R}^n$ be a sample and $R \in \mathbb{R}^{n_1 \times n}, W \in \mathbb{R}^{p \times p_1}$ be two properly distributed random projections. We develop an expected excess loss bound for the OLS estimator built on $(WXR, WY)$. Compared to an established bound for OLS estimator built on $(XR, Y)$, the gap is approximately $O\left( p_1 + C \frac{1}{p_1} \right)$, where $C$ scales with $n_1/n$ and can be negative for…
